label: Schopenhauer synthesized Buddhist Sunyata and cessation of desire with Western metaphysics
description: Arthur Schopenhauer's philosophical system was decisively shaped by grappling with "Sunyata (Emptiness & Dependent Arising)".
dialecticalTension: Dialectical engagement with the core claims and paradoxes of "Sunyata (Emptiness & Dependent Arising)".
historicalContext: Inherited and re-evaluated during the 19th Century Divergences.

label: Śaṅkara contended that relational emptiness without an absolute positive ground (Brahman) fails to account for consciousness and epistemic certainty
description: Adi Shankara formulated a fundamental critique of "Sunyata (Emptiness & Dependent Arising)", challenging its coherence and proposing an alternative model.
